bubbles.description: Corpus of the Era of the Martyrs (anno martyrum / anno Diocletiani): four-tuple = Coptic/Greek / Coptic & Greek scripts / Coptic numerals / Alexandrian calendar, epoch 1 Thoth = 29 August 284 (Diocletian's accession year by Alexandrian reckoning). bubbles.label: Gregorian calendar (Latin tradition)
bubbles.description: Corpus of Latin sources under the GREGORIAN calendar (four-tuple: Latin / Latin alphabet / Roman numerals / Gregorian), from 15 Oct 1582 onward. Awaiting its first assumed-held source (natural candidate: Clavius, Romani calendarii a Gregorio XIII restituti explicatio, 1603). Its birth is attested from OUTSIDE, by the Julian-Latin bull of 1582.

bubbles.label: Julian calendar (Latin tradition)
bubbles.description: Corpus of Latin sources under the JULIAN calendar (four-tuple: Latin / Latin alphabet / Roman numerals / Julian): Caesar's edict (45 BCE), Macrobius's Saturnalia (~430), Dionysius Exiguus's Easter table (525/532), Bede's Historia ecclesiastica (731), and the bull Inter gravissimas (24 Feb 1582, Julian — the corpus's last document, describing the Gregorian creation). All sources assumed held per owner rule (2026-11-15).
